about:
Encore Equipment LLC operates from Redmond, Oregon, where it has served the medical capital equipment market for more than 25 years. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The business supplies new, refurbished, and used medical capital equipment and also purchases equipment of all types from sellers. Its product focus includes lines such as Mac Medical warming cabinets. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers are primarily in the healthcare sector — hospitals, surgery centers, and clinics seeking capital equipment — though the company does not list specific client names or industries beyond medical capital equipment.

The stated mission emphasizes high-quality sales, pricing, and customer service, but the company does not articulate a specific founding purpose or competitive differentiation beyond breadth of inventory and buying capability.
